t: This is the tomb of Marie Lloyd in Hampstead Cemetery, in Camden. Born Matilda Alice Victoria Wood, she became the English music hall star known affectionately as the Queen of the Music Hall. Her songs included The Boy I Love Is Up in the Gallery, Don't Dilly Dally on the Way, and Oh Mr Porter What Shall I Do. Her use of innuendo and double entendre drew both criticism and praise, yet she enjoyed a long and prosperous career. She is commemorated here.
